findings.title: Await the async reschedule cleanup callbacks
findings.body: `forEach` discards the promises returned by these new async callbacks, so the surrounding try/catch no longer catches failures from `getCalendar`, including calendar-service constructor errors that were previously thrown synchronously. Such failures now become unhandled rejections while the function continues sending the reschedule email and returns success. Await a `Promise.all` over mapped callbacks (or use an awaited loop) so initialization and deletion failures reach the error handler. The same change is needed in `packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts`.
